new_training_intervention: history correction width only; 8 and12; preserve heads, loss, input transform, fixed /8, branch availability and zero output initialization
primary_adoption_metric: full_validation_raw_quantity_rmse at the original selected checkpoint
tail_boundary_rule: strictly greater than the original TRAIN-derived upper boundary; equality belongs to lower cell

seed_reporting.majority_screen: positive evidence for a dataset requires lower mean primary metric and at least2 of3 lower primary seed values; does not alone establish statistical significance

decision_categories.joint_improvement: mean full RMSE improves, majority seed screen passes, and mean MAE, tail RMSE and time NLL also do not worsen; disclose any adverse per-seed metrics
decision_categories.tradeoff: primary or tail quantity benefit accompanies MAE, body or time deterioration; do not label as general superiority or automatically promote
decision_categories.no_stable_capacity_gain: no lower primary mean, improvement supported by only one seed, or training gain without corresponding validation gain; retain as negative capacity evidence
decision_categories.invalid_or_incomplete: any missing seed, failed scientific/source/checkpoint checks or nonfinite metrics; cannot form a three-seed conclusion

scope_guards: Do not change user-fixed width16 baseline automatically
No new Test access for width8/12 selection
Do not select a different checkpoint for time/tail/MAE
Do not interpret width alone as a new backbone technique
CPU sampling diagnostic is not complete-population performance
Time location-scale algebra is descriptive, not causal training attribution
numeric_time_degradation_gate: No new arbitrary threshold or changed selection rule; show absolute/relative per-seed deterioration and require an explicit tradeoff decision before promotion
cnn_gru_target: Preserve/handle time calibration while improving quantity representation; change one module at a time and record parameter/compute budgets
